description: This file defines the SimpleQueueCacheCursor class, which implements the IQueueCacheCursor interface for iterating over a simple queue cache in Orleans streaming. It manages cursor position, stream filtering, and logging for cache traversal.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheCursor
classes.description: Implements a cursor for traversing a simple queue cache in Orleans streaming, supporting navigation, stream filtering, and logging.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current batch container and outputs any exception encountered.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next message in the stream, considering stream filtering.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the cursor position based on a new stream sequence token.

methods.name: RecordDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Marks the current message as failed to deliver.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the cursor, releasing resources.
